scope: All 236 function effective role privileges and full SQL-definition hashes, 88 relation ACL/RLS, 32 role-schema grants, 46 table-statistics, 1 bounded subscription aggregate, nonsecret DB GUC names/values. This is catalog SQL role reachability, NOT actual hosted PostgREST/JWT exposure or signed-in access testing.

queries.name: functions
queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,p.proname AS name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_args,p.oid::regprocedure::text AS signature,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_md5,p.prosecdef AS security_definer,p.provolatile AS volatility,p.prokind AS kind,has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS anon_execute_grant,has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS authenticated_execute_grant,has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS service_execute_grant,(has_schema_privilege('anon',n.oid,'USAGE') AND has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) AS anon_sql_effective,(has_schema_privilege('authenticated',n.oid,'USAGE') AND has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) AS authenticated_sql_effective FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private','auth','storage','realtime','vault','graphql_public','extensions') ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),p.oid;

queries.name: relations
queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS name,c.relkind AS kind,c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled,c.relforcerowsecurity AS force_rls,has_schema_privilege('anon',n.oid,'USAGE') AS anon_schema_usage,has_schema_privilege('authenticated',n.oid,'USAGE') AS authenticated_schema_usage,has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'SELECT') AS anon_select_grant,has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'SELECT') AS authenticated_select_grant,has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'INSERT') AS authenticated_insert_grant,has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'UPDATE') AS authenticated_update_grant,has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'DELETE') AS authenticated_delete_grant,md5(COALESCE(c.relacl::text,'')||':'||c.relrowsecurity::text||':'||c.relforcerowsecurity::text) AS acl_rls_md5 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private','auth','storage','realtime','vault','graphql_public','extensions') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;

queries.name: schemas
queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,r.rolname AS role,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE') AS usage_grant,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'CREATE') AS create_grant FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN pg_roles r WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private','auth','storage','realtime','vault','graphql_public','extensions') AND r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role','authenticator') ORDER BY n.nspname,r.rolname;

queries.name: subscription
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS aggregate_row_count FROM realtime.subscription;

queries.name: guc
queries.sql: SELECT current_setting('pgrst.db_schemas',true) AS connection_pgrst_db_schemas,current_setting('pgrst.db_anon_role',true) AS connection_pgrst_anon_role,current_setting('row_security',true) AS row_security_setting,current_setting('session_replication_role',true) AS session_replication_role,(SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name='ssl') AS ssl_setting,(SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name='wal_level') AS wal_level;

queries.name: stats
queries.sql: SELECT schemaname AS schema,relname AS relation,n_live_tup AS estimated_live_rows,n_dead_tup AS estimated_dead_rows,seq_scan,idx_scan,n_tup_ins,n_tup_upd,n_tup_del FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname IN ('public','private') ORDER BY schemaname,relname;

findings.subject: application_public_private
findings.verdict: No anonymous effective SQL EXECUTE on 99 application functions; authenticated 10 public SECURITY DEFINER RPC functions intentional per source-reviewed behavior, but live signed JWT tests UNVERIFIED.

findings.subject: private_schema
findings.verdict: Authenticated schema USAGE and EXECUTE on 28 private application routines; not proof PostgREST exposes private, and independently authenticated access UNVERIFIED. Two admin delete functions retain raw anon EXECUTE but anon lacks private schema USAGE.

findings.subject: realtime.subscription
findings.verdict: Anonymous and authenticated schema usage/SELECT; RLS disabled, 0 live rows by aggregate COUNT. Hosted API exposure and provider-managed intended permission remain UNVERIFIED; no member rows read.

findings.subject: storage.objects/buckets
findings.verdict: Table grants coexist with RLS; no logged-in Storage REST policies or object fetch tested.

findings.subject: github_repo_visibility
findings.verdict: GitHub repo reports public; active operating guide expects private. Governance/visibility remediation belongs to #504 and owner; settings not changed.
